Super admin BillingPanel shows WebhookHealthCard ('Secret configured', correct webhook URL, recent events, refresh works) and TrialOfferEditor (flat=1500 saves + persists after reload, defaults restored).
critical_code_review_comments: subscriptions.py is 1485 lines — consider splitting webhook handlers, trial-offer, renewals into submodules for maintainability.

Login.jsx Field component passes prop `testid` and renders it as `data-testid` — clean; but earlier codebase snippets show `input[testid=...]` (attribute is emitted correctly via `data-testid`), just noting to keep this pattern consistent everywhere.
_wh_order_paid returns 'already_reconciled' for any unclaimable order — safe, but consider distinct result 'unknown_order' vs 'already_reconciled' for cleaner observability.

public_pay_link responds with `key_id` even when the link is paid/refunded/expired — minor info leak of the Razorpay public key; harmless (key is public) but tighten by omitting it once status != pending.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, webhook-health-card, trial-offer-editor, pay-link public page — all pass)
